finding.claim: ADR 0027's Consequences says kmctl update in an older bundle 'writes summary.md and warns until .okf/index.md links it'. kmctl update warns once. After that, kmctl check fails with 'error index .okf/summary.md not listed in .okf/index.md' until the user adds the line, and that error also fails the kmctl-check pre-commit hook and CI. Say that the check fails (as it does for the manifesto), and add a line to commands.md's init/update section, so a person who upgrades knows the one manual step.

fixes.change: at the operator's ruling on f4's behaviour, init and update insert the one index entry and a log line for a summary.md or manifesto.md they write into a kept index, so kmctl check passes after update; idempotent
init prints a linked line and --json a linked list instead of the warning; the init epilog names summary.md; the ack epilog says UTC time to the second
update on an old bundle links the summary and manifesto, check passes, a second update changes nothing; the warnings-count test becomes the linked-pages test
init and update say they link the summary and manifesto themselves; ack describes the timestamp
the update consequence says update adds the index and log lines; the ack bullet describes the timestamp
